about: Deliberate, owner-approved departures from the recorded Store. The recording is never edited; each departure is named here with its reason and checked by differential.test.mjs.

changes.reason: Common sense: when a board must be brought to a finished width and more than the router's 1 in cut width comes off, the router cuts through at the finished width (a rip) and the far strip is returned as an offcut, instead of the request being refused. Boards are brought to width before any part is cut.
changes.expect: Every package or item line the recording answered is answered identically, except lines whose refusal included EDGE_MILL_REMOVAL_EXCEEDS_D001_MAX_CUT_WIDTH, which are now SUPPORTABLE rips.

changes.reason: Alcove runs in the logical sequence the shared cut-package model determines, with no project-specific evaluator: boards are brought to width first, then cut, under the same retained-control rule as every other job. The project-shaped ALCOVE_INSERT_V1 request type and its evaluator are retired; an alcove is sent as cut packages.
changes.expect: No evaluator named evaluateAlcoveJob exists; every recorded Alcove answer is retired, not replayed.

changes.reason: The board-length ceiling had no basis in the machine and is removed. Every board length the Store offers is a board the cell takes, under the same rules on every path.
changes.expect: envelopeCheck answers differ only by losing that reason (and passing when it was the only one); user-defined board answers differ only in the boards they list as considered and passed over. No selected board, status or Q changes.

changes.reason: The grade is the customer's choice, never the yard's. A user-defined board names its grade; when the wood is offered in more than one grade and none is named, Store asks (GRADE_CHOICE_REQUIRED with the grades on offer) instead of choosing by length.
changes.expect: Every recorded user-defined board answer that named no grade for wood offered in several is now UNRESOLVED with GRADE_CHOICE_REQUIRED. Sent again with the grade the recording priced, each gives the same board, estimate and Q; only boards of other grades leave the considered list.

changes.reason: A missing manufacturing fact is never filled in. A cut package with no end-cut angle is UNRESOLVED (END_CUT_ANGLE_REQUIRED), not a square cut. A user-defined board with no miter angle, cut plane, Datum-C method or operation list, or whose declared operations disagree with the parts, is UNRESOLVED with that reason. A sheet package states that every piece is returned.
changes.expect: Cut-package answers that sent no end-cut angle: each such package is UNRESOLVED with END_CUT_ANGLE_REQUIRED, and with the angle the recording assumed (0) stated explicitly the whole answer is the recorded one. User-defined board answers that now name a missing or contradictory fact were already UNRESOLVED.

changes.reason: A user-defined board states its end relation and length datum. The travel model prices parallel ends with the length on the long-long outer edge; a missing relation or datum is asked for, and other geometry or an extra end identity is refused, instead of being priced as if it were parallel.
changes.expect: Every recorded user-defined board answer named no geometry: without it each is UNRESOLVED with END_RELATION_REQUIRED (or the definition gap it already had); with the priced geometry stated, each is the recorded answer, every field and both calculation hashes.

changes.reason: A user-defined board states its wood and size (species, nominal thickness, nominal width), as cut packages already must. A missing material constraint used to mean no constraint, so Store matched every board in the yard and chose one. It is UNRESOLVED, MATERIAL_CHOICE_REQUIRED; Store does not pick a wood or a size.
changes.expect: Exactly the recorded user-defined board answers whose definition states no complete material change: each is now UNRESOLVED with MATERIAL_CHOICE_REQUIRED and no estimate. Every other answer replays unchanged.

changes.reason: Store does not name a customer's feature or fill in a material form. A spot with no featureId used to be given a positional name (<partId>-SPOT-<n>) and priced; a cut package with no material form used to be treated as board and priced. Each is UNRESOLVED: FEATURE_ID_REQUIRED or MATERIAL_FORM_REQUIRED, with no price. The same rule holds on the user-defined board and long-part paths.
changes.expect: Exactly the recorded cut-package answers that sent a spot with no featureId or a package with no material form change: each such package is UNRESOLVED with FEATURE_ID_REQUIRED (asked first) or MATERIAL_FORM_REQUIRED and no price, and no such answer is SUPPORTABLE. With what the recording assumed stated explicitly (form board, each spot named by its position, and a square cut where NO-SILENT-DEFINITION-DEFAULTS applies) the answer is the recorded one, except that the stated form is echoed. No user-defined board answer changes: the two recorded boards with no form state no material and are asked for it under MATERIAL-IS-STATED.

changes.reason: Owner-directed Stage-2 sheet capability: one 0.5-in router (not 0.25); preserve X 24..72 and Y 6..42 routing field on 96x48 sheet; 1-in tabs retaining >=5% of routed contour with <=24-in free span, user-chosen positions immutable; YARD-PANEL-SAW full crosscuts and rips at $10 per cut with declared +/-0.25-in position tolerance and no hourly saw double-charge; PATTERN offsets an existing defined aperture without creating a duplicate route; physical status remains not commissioned.
changes.expect: Preserve all non-sheet evaluator results and immutable recordings. Updated sheet answers are versioned S001-STAGE2-ENVELOPE-0.2 with the half-inch cutter, geometric tab evidence and separate manual-cut economics. Unsupported features and geometry remain refused. The canonical Playhouse request with 4 requested auto-planned tabs receives 7 actual aperture tabs (plus 2 split tabs); it is never advertised as just 4.

changes.reason: The recorded Store's catalog listed three operations in supportedOps that no evaluator, there or here, ever modeled. The owner had them removed from Store's operation vocabulary and catalog: Store offers only operations it handles. A job asking for an operation outside the vocabulary is refused OP_NOT_ON_OFFERING.
changes.expect: The frozen recorded catalog and answers are unchanged on disk. Replay reduces recorded offered-operation lists to the current vocabulary, and every other field of every recorded answer reproduces exactly.
